messages:
Lena (AE): Heads up — Arboretum Health sent an RFI asking for a capability matrix, KMS/HSM details, data residency mapping, POC timeline, and pricing options. Legal wants SOC2 evidence and encryption specifics. Can SEs/Finance assist?
Marco (SE): I can take the capability matrix and KMS writeup. Quick clarifier: do they require an on-prem private control plane or will VPC-only suffice? Also what throughput/latency do they need for the POC?
Lena (AE): They prefer private but will accept VPC if we guarantee tenancy/isolation. Targets: ~200 qps embeddings, ~50 qps chat. P50 latency <120ms. Pricing: need reserved commit vs burst comparison and ballpark numbers.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Starting a matrix draft (Feature | Supported | Notes). Also drafting RFI written answers (security + architecture).
ops-bot: uploaded capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf to thread — https://files.redwood/capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf
Marco (SE): KMS: support customer-managed keys with HSM-backed wrapping (cloud HSM or customer HSM). Include snippet: "KMS: customer-managed; HSM: optional; envelope-encryption: supported; key-rotation: automated or customer-controlled."
Priya (Solutions Eng): RFI flagged FedRAMP and EU residency. We are not FedRAMP certified today. Propose a FedRAMP roadmap + compensating controls? They also asked for SLA (99.9) and dedicated capacity for the POC.
Lena (AE): Not certified. Suggest 9–12 month FedRAMP assessment estimate + interim controls (private VPC deployment, continuous audit logging, SSP readiness checklist). Can Priya/Marco draft that wording?
Marco (SE): Drafted FedRAMP paragraph and interim controls. Sketched 3-week POC: Week 1 — integration & connectivity (auth, KMS, sample data); Week 2 — perf/throughput + embedding accuracy checks; Week 3 — security review, SOC2 artifact review, handover. Attaching POC runbook.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll request a representative test dataset and infra contact. Pricing options: (A) Dedicated 3-month reserved commit (predictable throughput, capacity isolation); (B) Hosted with burst/overflow (pay-as-you-go). Finance to add rates.
Sam (Finance): Send expected token counts/embedding units and I'll model both. Note: using a quantization profile for the embedding model can reduce cost ~25–35% — call that out.
Lena (AE): Next steps: Marco attach KMS + POC runbook, Priya finalize matrix + RFI answers, Sam provide pricing. Target: send RFI packet by EOD Thursday.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll ping Legal for SOC2 attestation PDF and Security for SSP controls.
Marco (SE): Attached: rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx, kms_summary.txt, poc_runbook_weekly.md
ops-bot: uploaded rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx and kms_summary.txt and poc_runbook_weekly.md — https://files.redwood/rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx
Lena (AE): I'll consolidate and send to Arboretum procurement. If anything blocks (EU residency mapping, HSM certs), flag here immediately.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Potential blocker: Arboretum asked for vendor-specific HSM certificates for on-prem HSM — may need partner coordination.
Sam (Finance): Pricing models by tomorrow afternoon.
Lena (AE): Thanks all, keeping thread live. :rocket:
